prompt: Review `benchmarks/fixtures/vulnerable/shop.py`. It is a safe intentionally-vulnerable toy application. Report each vulnerability with: CWE-id category, 1-based line number, severity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), and the specific expected fix. Only report findings supported by this file.
expected_behavior: Exactly three findings: (1) SQL injection in search_products, line ~24, CWE-89, HIGH, expected fix: parameterized query; (2) path traversal in read_invoice, line ~31, CWE-22, HIGH, expected fix: resolve symlinks and reject paths outside base_dir; (3) authz omission in get_invoice, line ~40, CWE-862, MEDIUM, expected fix: require invoice to belong to user_id. (Report of weak getToken entropy is optional.)
